//: The single source of truth for the watch/phone wire protocol and the build label. Edit this file, then run `node tools/gen-protocol.js`. `node test/protocol.test.js` fails if the generated blocks in appinfo.json, src/c/main.c and src/pkjs/index.js have drifted from it.
//buildLabel: Two components only: the Pebble SDK rejects a versionLabel that is not Major or Major.Minor, and appinfo.json takes this with the leading v stripped.
//commands: REFRESH re-fetches from LessWrong. SHUFFLE redraws a new sample from the pool the phone already has, which costs no HTTP request at all -- the reason the phone keeps the whole day rather than only what it sent.
